## Decisions
- Package name: `offgrid-ai` (unscoped)
- Install: curl primary, npm secondary
- No Homebrew distribution
- Pi is mandatory (onboarding step 3) — not optional
- Model backends: LM Studio (recommended) → Ollama → oMLX
- RAM-based model recommendations (≤8GB: Gemma 4 E2B, ≤16GB: Gemma 4 E4B, ≤32GB: Qwen 3.5 9B, ≥48GB: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B)
- No auto-download of models — show commands, user runs them
- No `lms` bootstrapping or PATH hacking — just tell users to open LM Studio
- `--verbose` flag shows brew/lms/ollama output; default is quiet
- llama-server: spawn with stdio:inherit (verbose) or stdio:pipe (quiet, show errors on fail)
- ESLint with no-undef rule enforced in CI
- node:test for smoke tests (built-in, no dependencies)
